title: Industrial Sketch
description: Croquis de présentation en design industriel combinant des traits d'encre rapides et lâches avec de larges coups de marqueur à alcool translucides. Présente des lignes de construction visibles, des ombres hachurées, des annotations manuscrites et un bloc graphique de couleur en arrière-plan sur papier texturé.
description_en: Industrial design presentation sketch combining loose, rapid ink linework with broad, translucent alcohol marker strokes. Features visible construction lines, hatched shadows, handwritten annotations, and a stark graphic block of background color on textured paper.
description_fr: Croquis de présentation en design industriel combinant des traits d'encre rapides et lâches avec de larges coups de marqueur à alcool translucides. Présente des lignes de construction visibles, des ombres hachurées, des annotations manuscrites et un bloc graphique de couleur en arrière-plan sur papier texturé.
prompt: Industrial design presentation sketch, ink fineliner and alcohol marker on heavy textured drafting paper. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The rendering relies on loose, rapid black ink linework with varying pressure sensitivity. Contours are intentionally sketchy and non-continuous, featuring overshooting construction lines that extend past corners to reveal the underlying geometric structure. Shadows and ambient occlusion are defined by expressive, diagonal cross-hatching. Volume is established using broad, translucent marker strokes in {{primary_color}}, showing visible overlap and varying saturation where strokes intersect. A bold, stark graphic block of {{accent_color}} marker strokes acts as an abstract backdrop element behind the main focal points, flattening the spatial dynamics slightly while emphasizing the foreground. Localized material details are highlighted sparingly in {{secondary_color}}. The composition is peppered with hand-lettered annotations, cursive design notes, and callout arrows integrated directly into the visual flow. Grounded by loose, hatched floor shadows that anchor the perspective. Lighting is directional but illustrated purely through ink density and marker layering rather than realistic shading. The tactile quality of rough paper fiber and slight ink bleed into the page is highly visible, enhancing the raw, drafted aesthetic. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners.
